_readme: S703 (worker glendale; d-glendale-own-pages-filed-as-gaps-s703). Glendale's 11 programs with no record file (f-glendale-28-left-s697), each filed with the page and control number that free page read 45016708970 found (customFields.eL_programControlNumber in each tab's own Coursedog data) and one of three reasons. The state's lists come from coci_program_courses, read by the conductor 2026-11-22; every noncredit course there is at 0 units. No model call, no Supabase write: no row exists for these programs, and the capture holds no text for them, so a read with only= naming them refuses (only_refused). The follow-up lever: a tab whose own data names a listed program is that program's candidate (_ranked/candidates), which the extraction's coverage bar would still stop.

reasons.own_page_coverage_low: Own page found by its program data; the page prints few of the state's listed courses, so the coarse net refused it.
reasons.no_own_page: No page in the catalog is the program's own; the nearest page's data names a sibling.
reasons.wrong_tab_hold: A page held by, or near-missed for, a program its data does not name.
